title: paeonia corallina var. russoi
intro: Paeonia corallina var. russoi, commonly known as the Russian peony, is a plant species belonging to the Paeoniaceae family. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its ability to provide relief from pain and inflammation, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The health benefits of Paeonia corallina var. russoi include reducing fever, relieving menstrual cramps, and alleviating anxiety. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
